about: St. Thomas is in Elgin County, south of London in southwestern Ontario, on a ridge above Kettle Creek. It branded itself the Railway City after decades as a major rail junction, and a statue of Jumbo the elephant still marks that era. A compact downtown, Pinafore Park, and the restored CASO station sit among older neighbourhoods. About 43,000 people live in St. Thomas.
